_comment: SPEC-BLOCO-03 pieces 2 and 3 at commit 5d85a46 (instant-win-audit, feat/keptra-lote-contratos, worktree v2-lote; Adenda Z1), compiled with forge 1.5.1 under that commit’s foundry.toml: solc 0.8.21, evm paris, via_ir, 200 runs. Creation code, selectors and the ABI of each contract: the fork suite deploys the code, and the T18 tests hold every ABI entry the bridge and the page use against the ABI compiled here. KeptraEscrow deploys KeptraReputation and KeptraGuarantee deploys KeptraVoucher. The escrow’s hash is Z1’s, and the one piece 4 pins at df37231 (OracleReceiver.fork.t.sol ESCROW_CREATION_CODE_HASH). Hashes are written without the 0x prefix: the repository refuses any 32-byte hex literal, the shape of a private key (F2).
